extracted.name: 3-Min Pumpkin Mug Cake
extracted.description: Super quick Pumpkin dessert!!! 🎃 This mug cake is sticky, moist, and fulfilling! The combination of maple syrup and pumpkin is absolutely incredible. It should definitely be a year-round dessert with how much joy it brings!!!
instruction_lines: In a mug, add the following ingredients in the order of butter, milk, syrup, and pumpkin puree. Mix well.
Continue adding flour, baking powder, pumpkin spice, and salt in order. Mix until the batter is smooth, without any flour chunks.
Microwave the mug for 1 minute 30 seconds.
Delicious Pumpkin Mug Cake ready to serve!
